matrix_name.name: carboxyl-containing polyimide
matrix_name.description: Carboxyl-containing polyimide (PIC) fibers prepared by wet spinning, followed by high-temperature cyclization and hot drawing. Fibers were activated in 0.5 M NaOH solution, treated in 0.1 M NiSO4 solution for ion exchange, and then in 0.1 M NaBH4 solution to form Ni nanoparticle catalytic seeds.

fillers.name: copper
fillers.description: Electroless plated copper layer. The plating process was catalyzed by nickel nanoparticles (Ni NPs) embedded on the PIC fiber surface.
